purpose.why: The larger goal is Task obsession — make every Barkpark change flow through one discoverable, evidence-bearing task by mechanism rather than discipline. The concrete problem was that task usage depended on discipline, so hotfixes, rejected duplicates, and landed branches could bypass or lose their owning record. Adding find-or-create, close digests, overlap notices, hotfix auto-filing, and CI reference/re-land gates was the correct intervention because mechanical checks at creation, work, and merge boundaries cover the lifecycle without relying on contributor memory. If omitted, changes land without purpose or evidence, duplicate work races silently, and the ledger cannot explain main.
